name: Midland Commons
summary: Midland Commons is a 225,000 square foot suburban retail center strategically located along Bald Hill Road in Warwick, Rhode Island, with direct access to I-95 and I-295. The center features strong anchors including Dick's Sporting Goods, Burlington, and Planet Fitness, complemented by nearby shadow anchors like Walmart and Kohl's.
demographics: Midland Commons serves a diverse suburban Rhode Island market along the I-95/I-295 corridor, attracting middle-income families and value-conscious shoppers from Warwick and surrounding communities. The trade area draws from a mix of working professionals, young families, and retirees seeking convenient access to big-box retailers and everyday shopping needs. The center's tenant mix of Dick's Sporting Goods, Burlington, and Planet Fitness, along with nearby Walmart and Kohl's, appeals to budget-minded consumers prioritizing value and practicality over luxury shopping experiences.
description: Midland Commons is a strategically positioned suburban retail center located at 650 Bald Hill Road in Warwick, Rhode Island, offering 225,000 square feet of retail space along one of the market's most dominant retail corridors. The center benefits from exceptional accessibility, sitting adjacent to both I-95 and I-295, making it a convenient destination for shoppers throughout the greater Providence area. The property features a strong tenant lineup anchored by Dick's Sporting Goods, Burlington, and Planet Fitness, providing a compelling mix of sporting goods, off-price fashion, and fitness amenities. The center's strategic location is further enhanced by its proximity to major shadow anchors including Walmart, Kohl's, At Home, and Raymour & Flannigan, creating a powerful retail cluster that drives consistent traffic. With available space and a proven track record in one of Rhode Island's premier retail markets, Midland Commons continues to serve as a vital shopping destination for the region's residents.
